title: Bed — one Math Engine, divan, mattress, boards and pillows
description:
A parametric BED on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A NODE, A SEGMENT OR A SPACE. On a node it stands where the node is; on a segment or a space the bed takes the host's own direction (a space uses its LONGEST edge), so a bed placed against a wall lies along it without a rotation being typed.

WHAT IT BUILDS. Four legs, a divan base, a headboard — a footboard when asked — a mattress inset inside the boards, and any number of pillows laid across the head end. Every part is a QUAD swept from z0 to z1, and the whole assembly is ONE table of quads that the shared kernel turns into a face list in a single pass; adding a part is one more row and one more `vcat` operand.

THE PILLOW ROW IS ONE BROADCAST, not a loop: `(arange(n) + 0.5) * W / n - W/2` is every pillow's centre line at once, and the four corner columns follow from it, so 2 pillows and 6 pillows cost the same.

WHY QUADS AND NOT BOXES. A quad prism takes four ARBITRARY plan corners, so the same six lines that build an axis-aligned divan also build a rotated or tapered part. Nothing in the kernel knows which it is.

THE PLAN IS DERIVED, NOT DRAWN AGAIN — the 2D outlines are the same quads with z dropped, so plan and model cannot disagree. Each part is its own 2D row because a grouped outline list is read EVEN-ODD: the mattress sits INSIDE the divan outline, and in one row that would void it into a hole instead of drawing over it.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: 2.00 × 1.50 m, 1.05 m to the top of the headboard, mattress top at 0.62 m, 2.83 m² of sleeping surface.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. The frame is a divan — a slatted or four-poster bed is a different body, not a different slider. Nothing is mitred: parts interpenetrate at the joints rather than meeting cleanly. Pillows are rectangular blocks, not soft bodies.

params.name: Bed maths
params.expr:
# Natural size — the fit scale is measured against the unscaled length
_natL = length
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
# Scaled dimensions
_Ln = length * _s
_Wd = width * _s
_legH = legHeight * _s
_baseH = baseHeight * _s
_matT = mattressThk * _s
_bdT = boardThk * _s
_hbH = headboardHeight * _s
_fbH = footboardHeight * _s
_pilL = pillowLength * _s
_pilD = pillowDepth * _s
_pilT = pillowThk * _s
_u0 = 0 - _Ln / 2
_u1 = _Ln / 2
_v0 = 0 - _Wd / 2
_v1 = _Wd / 2
_baseTop = _legH + _baseH
_matTop = _baseTop + _matT
_hasFb = footboard > 0
_bodyL = _Ln
_bodyW = _Wd
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
# Parts — legs, divan, boards, mattress, pillows
_lg = 0.07 * _s
_lgi = 0.015 * _s
_L1 = hcat(_u0 + _lgi, _v0 + _lgi, _u0 + _lgi + _lg, _v0 + _lgi, _u0 + _lgi + _lg, _v0 + _lgi + _lg, _u0 + _lgi, _v0 + _lgi + _lg, 0, _legH, 5)
_L2 = hcat(_u1 - _lgi - _lg, _v0 + _lgi, _u1 - _lgi, _v0 + _lgi, _u1 - _lgi, _v0 + _lgi + _lg, _u1 - _lgi - _lg, _v0 + _lgi + _lg, 0, _legH, 5)
_L3 = hcat(_u1 - _lgi - _lg, _v1 - _lgi - _lg, _u1 - _lgi, _v1 - _lgi - _lg, _u1 - _lgi, _v1 - _lgi, _u1 - _lgi - _lg, _v1 - _lgi, 0, _legH, 5)
_L4 = hcat(_u0 + _lgi, _v1 - _lgi - _lg, _u0 + _lgi + _lg, _v1 - _lgi - _lg, _u0 + _lgi + _lg, _v1 - _lgi, _u0 + _lgi, _v1 - _lgi, 0, _legH, 5)
_BASE = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v1, _u0, _v1, _legH, _baseTop, 1)
_HB = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u0 + _bdT, _v0, _u0 + _bdT, _v1, _u0, _v1, _legH, _legH + _hbH, 3)
_FBr = hcat(_u1 - _bdT, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v1, _u1 - _bdT, _v1, _legH, _legH + _fbH, 3)
_FB = _hasFb ? _FBr : zeros(0, 11)
_mu1 = _u1 - (_hasFb ? _bdT : 0)
_MAT = hcat(_u0 + _bdT, _v0 + 0.02 * _s, _mu1, _v0 + 0.02 * _s, _mu1, _v1 - 0.02 * _s, _u0 + _bdT, _v1 - 0.02 * _s, _baseTop, _matTop, 2)
# Pillows — one row per pillow, spread across the width in a single broadcast
_npil = max(0, round(pillows))
_pvc = (arange(_npil) + 0.5) * _Wd / max(1, _npil) - _Wd / 2
_pu0 = fill(_npil, 1, _u0 + _bdT + 0.04 * _s)
_pu1 = _pu0 + _pilD
_pva = _pvc - _pilL / 2
_pvb = _pvc + _pilL / 2
_PIL = hcat(_pu0, _pva, _pu1, _pva, _pu1, _pvb, _pu0, _pvb, fill(_npil,1,_matTop), fill(_npil,1,_matTop + _pilT), fill(_npil,1,4))
Q = vcat(_L1, _L2, _L3, _L4, _BASE, _HB, _FB, _MAT, _PIL)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Divan3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Mattress3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Boards3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 3)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Pillows3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 4)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Legs3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 5)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
DivanPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
MattressPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
BoardsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 3)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
PillowsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 4)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
overallLength = _Ln
overallWidth = _Wd
overallHeight = _legH + max(_hbH, _baseH + _matT)
mattressTop = _matTop
sleepArea = (_mu1 - _u0 - _bdT) * (_Wd - 0.04 * _s)
footprint = _Ln * _Wd
